title: LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.17697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI systems now write long and difficult mathematical proofs, and checking their step-by-step validity is becoming a bottleneck. A learned verifier could check proofs cheaply, but training one requires a correctness label on every step, and such labels are hard to obtain for open-ended proofs. Existing methods take them from human annotators, which is costly, or derive them from final answers, which proofs do not have, and formalizing each proof in Lean requires expert effort. We introduce LeanPRM, a framework that uses the Lean proof assistant to create step-level labels for natural-language proofs. A model writes a natural-language proof together with a paired formal proof, without feedback from Lean. Lean then labels every step, and a second model discards failures caused only by the formal syntax, so that the negative labels mark errors in the mathematics. translated_title: LeanPRM：基于Lean的自然语言证明验证过程监督
translated_abstract: 如今，AI系统能够撰写冗长且困难的数学证明，而逐步验证其有效性正成为瓶颈。学习型验证器可以低成本地检查证明，但训练这样的验证器需要对每一步进行正确性标注，而这类标签对于开放式证明来说很难获得。现有方法要么依赖人工标注者（成本高昂），要么从最终答案中推导标签（而证明本身没有最终答案），且用Lean形式化每个证明需要专家投入大量精力。我们提出了LeanPRM，这是一个利用Lean证明助手为自然语言证明创建步骤级标签的框架。一个模型在没有Lean反馈的情况下，同时撰写自然语言证明及其配对的形式化证明；随后Lean对每一步进行标注，再由第二个模型过滤掉仅由形式化语法导致的失败，使负标签只标记数学本身存在的错误。LeanPRM包含10,634个证明、152K个带标签的步骤，且完全无需人工标注。
tldr: LeanPRM利用Lean证明助手自动为自然语言数学证明生成步骤级正确性标签，无需人工标注即可构建包含10,634个证明、15.2万个标注步骤的过程监督数据集，解决了证明验证器训练中标签获取困难的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: LeanPRM leverages the Lean proof assistant to automatically generate step-level correctness labels for natural-language mathematical proofs, building a dataset of 10,634 proofs with 152K labeled steps without any human annotation, addressing the bottleneck of obtaining training labels for proof verifiers.
